title: Handoff Transfer
description: What actually crosses a lane boundary in a rendered ## Upstream Outputs section. Added 2026-09-19 to close the 'validate on read' gap: create_handoff.py's cross-lane wiring (process-manifest.json depends_on) points a downstream lane at an upstream file path, but until this schema nothing checked that file was well-formed before handing it over -- it was trusted by construction.
